title: mRpostman 3.0.0 (2026-08-29 major release: the 2026 refactoring)
text: Unified argument names: every method takes mailbox name now calls folder (previously name folder/ACL/metadata/quota methods to_folder copy_msg()/move_msg()), expunge() takes msg_id like every message operation (previously msg_uid). old argument names keep working deprecated aliases. Positional calls unaffected. last self-contained retry loops (folder listing/management, quota, capabilities, like - 21 internal files) collapsed onto single execution engine, every libcurl command now shares retry, state-restoration, error policy. OAuth 2.0 vignette now uses httr2 (successor httr, maintenance mode) token flows. BREAKING: use_uid now defaults TRUE (connection-level setting configure_imap()). UIDs stable lifetime message; sequence numbers renumber whenever messages expunged, made old default correctness trap script searches, deletes, fetches. Set configure_imap(use_uid = FALSE) (per call) restore old behavior. Connection-level defaults: use_uid, mute, retries can now set configure_imap() apply every method; call can still override . threading use_uid = TRUE every call script. attachment family, 5 entry points -> 2 (+1 offline): ImapCon$attachments() downloads (BODYSTRUCTURE-guided, parts = specific MIME parts dest = destination), ImapCon$attachments_manifest() lists without downloading, exported extract_attachments() reports writes attachments already-fetched bodies (returning zero-row data frames, never NA, messages without attachments). fetch_attachments(), fetch_attachment_parts(), fetch_attachments_list(), get_attachments(), list_attachments() keep working soft-deprecated. Deprecations lifecycle: 15 search_*() methods (every one direct query() spelling) ()/() (criteria combine R’s &, |, !) now signal -per-session deprecation warning. Nothing removed. print(con) now shows compact summary (server, user, TLS, selected folder) instead dumping whole R6 object, never prints credentials. con$has_capability("ESEARCH"): direct predicate advertised capabilities. decode_mime_text() exported: body-text counterpart decode_mime_header(). metadata_options() now lists capability-gated extension attributes (PREVIEW, SAVEDATE, MODSEQ) fetch_metadata() accepts. query language: new ImapCon$query() searches ordinary R expression, e.g. con$query((subject == "budget" | "budget 3") & flag != "SEEN" & size > 5e6). Fields: subject, , , cc, bcc, body, text (== means contains), flag (system flags custom keywords, != maps UN* forms), size bytes age seconds (>, >=, <, <=), date fields sent, date, saved (>=, >, <, <=, ==, exact day granularity), header("Name"). Expressions combine &, |, !, %% (one field, several values), parentheses, R’s precedence; variables criterion constructors evaluated caller’s environment, bare string next | inherits field preceding comparison. translation pure internal function, exercised offline test suite expected protocol strings. Verbatim criteria verbatim(): raw protocol fragments dedicated field — vendor extensions Gmail’s X-GM-RAW, sequence sets like UID 100:200, FUZZY matches — wrapped first-class criteria compose query language criterion constructors, e.g. con$query(verbatim('X-GM-RAW ":attachment"') & flag != "SEEN"). query language thereby covers everything raw custom search() can express. Attachment extraction rebuilt real MIME parser: get_attachments() list_attachments() now walk multipart tree boundary (recursively) instead scraping raw text regular expressions, fetch_attachments() guided BODYSTRUCTURE server reports, fetching attachment exact MIME part. fixes payloads corrupted leftover boundary header fragments, attachments nested multipart/alternative/related structures, quoted-printable attachments (previously skipped), filenames RFC 2231 form (filename*=UTF-8''...), unquoted filenames, filenames containing --, stray NUL byte appended as_is = TRUE. Payloads verified byte-identically server-side decode (fetch_binary()) test suite. actionable error oversized results: SEARCH matching many thousands messages can produce id list larger libcurl accepts one response line (CURLE_TOO_LARGE); now fails message recommending esearch = TRUE, esearch_*() aggregations, narrower criteria, instead generic request error. Native operators criteria: criterion constructors (string(), flag(), sent_since(), …) now return classed objects combine &, |, ! directly, e.g. con$search(string("budget", = "SUBJECT") & !flag("SEEN")). () () keep working unchanged.

title: mRpostman 3.0.0 (2026-08-29 major release: the 2026 refactoring)
text: One execution choke point: libcurl transport now goes single internal engine (imap_exec()) sets command shared handle fetches back back, nothing , capability check state fetch can longer overwrite pending command (bug class behind several historical fixes). retry policy lives : retryable failure session state - ENABLEd extensions selected folder - restored command replayed. Classed error conditions: every failure now signaled mRpostman_error specific subclass (mRpostman_connection_error, mRpostman_state_error, mRpostman_capability_error, mRpostman_server_error - carrying server’s reason $server_reply -, mRpostman_response_too_large), callers can tryCatch() failure kinds instead matching message text. Offline tests command layer: transport now mockable (testthat >= 3.1.7), canned-response tests covering request assembly, retry contract, error class; four copies sandbox probe test suite consolidated one helper. Dead code removed (two unreachable internal files), along ~40 Sys.sleep() output-flush races ~44 -op rm() calls. declared R dependency wrong: package uses deparse1() (R >= 4.0) isFALSE() (R >= 3.5) declaring R (>= 3.1.0); now requires R (>= 4.1.0). rejected STORE (e.g. non-existent flag) reported success: error check anchored start whole response (begins server greeting), tagged made error handler fail. Flag operations now scan every response line report server’s reason. retry path fetch engine drifted main path: retried fetch_text(base64_decode = TRUE) returned raw base64, retried fetch_metadata() cleaned without attribute list, first-try retry write_to_disk = TRUE failed internal error, write_to_disk keep_in_mem = FALSE grew result list size message id. retry now re-issues fetch flows processing first try. literal # fetch request (e.g. header-field name) replaced message id; id placeholder substituted now. SEARCH responses split across several untagged `* SEARCHlines now read full (previously first line parsed), theALLsequence-set anESEARCHresponse read untagged* ESEARCH` line, never message content. internal search-result repair longer errors stripped id last element response. 14 criterion constructors called argument checker positionally, silently disabling validation (e.g. (42) accepted); use_uid likewise never validated flag operations. calls named now. server-error log package-level global shared every connection session, one connection’s reply attributed another’s failure; error reporting now reads calling connection’s log. duplicate definition message-deletion internal (two files defining function different signatures) removed. raw socket layer now uses poll() instead select() (undefined behavior file descriptors 1024), honors timeout <= 0 “limit” instead failing immediately, checks user interrupts waiting, wedged server longer makes R session uninterruptible. Documentation corrected contradicted code: keep_in_mem (default TRUE, FALSE) polarity mute four fetch methods, return value search(), two parameters documented fetch_metadata() exist. criterion constructors now document return value.

THREAD=REFS: thread(algorithm = "REFS") (Dovecot’s threading references ).
